source_caption:
Children of Heaven is one of those films that finds something beautiful in the simplest things. A pair of shoes, two siblings, and a little girl running to school become the heart of a story that feels both heartbreaking and full of hope. It's a reminder of how much emotion a film can carry without needing to say too much.

The film also made history as the first Iranian film to receive an Oscar nomination, bringing Iranian cinema to a much wider audience. It even won Best Picture at the Fajr Film Festival in 1997.

🎥: Children of Heaven (1997)
Dir. Majid Majidi

source_details.title: Children of Heaven
source_details.synopsis: Children of Heaven (Persian: بچه‌های آسمان, romanized: Baččehā-ye āsmān) is a 1997 Iranian family drama film written and directed by Majid Majidi. The plot follows a brother and sister, and their adventures over a lost pair of shoes. It received positive reviews, and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film in 1998.
